subject: Playshop: Commit & Stage definition realignment — FY27 Q3
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: salesops@cloudmarq.io
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Playshop: Commit & Stage definition realignment — FY27 Q3

Team —

Quick note: finance asked us to push a tighter alignment on what we mark as Commit vs Best Case for FY27 Q3 forecasting. The goal is simple: reduce slippage at commit by making sure stage gating is consistent across AE teams and that Sales Ops can trust the rollup.

I attached a short draft that:
- proposes tightened criteria for Commit (documentation, signed timeline, PO/LOI or equivalent)
- clarifies Best Case (high confidence but missing at least one formal approval item)
- maps current HubSpot stages to the new taxonomy

Can we run a 90-minute playshop next week to:
1) walk through the draft definitions (15m)
2) play through 3 real deals (40m)
3) agree on a cutover plan and comms (20m)

Proposed time: Tue 29 Jun 2027 10:00–11:30 PT. Monica — can you own the agenda and the deck? Laura — finance will need a 2-week lead to consume reports after cutover; please advise acceptable freeze window.

Attaching: 2027-06-25-commit-stage-defs-draft.pdf and playshop-agenda-v2.docx.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: 2027-06-25-commit-stage-defs-draft.pdf (application/pdf), playshop-agenda-v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Playshop: Commit & Stage definition realignment — FY27 Q3

Diego —

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed the PDF and suggested a couple of small language tweaks in the doc (inline comments) to make the Commit criteria less prescriptive around paperwork for enterprise prospects that already have a standing purchase agreement.

Practical asks:
- I can host the playshop and will build a short Mural with the taxonomy mapping exercise.
- For the run-through deals, I recommend we anonymize and use "Deal A" (mid-market), "Deal B" (enterprise renewal), and "Deal C" (new logos) so reps are comfortable sharing.
- HubSpot mapping: I have a spreadsheet with stage->taxonomy mapping; link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xYhubspot-map (internal). I'll attach the mapping file to the calendar invite.

Cc'ing Laura for the freeze window. Also looping in CloudMarq (cc) as they asked to observe for their partner onboarding efforts.

Monica Patel
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Playshop: Commit & Stage definition realignment — FY27 Q3

All —

Appreciate the initiative. A couple of concerns from the field:
1) If we tighten Commit criteria now and change historical definitions, quarter-to-quarter comparability will be impacted. We need a clear communications plan and a retrospective mapping for last two quarters in reporting.
2) AE incentive language references "Closed/Commit" in some plans — we should coordinate with Comp so there is no unintended pay impact.

Proposal:
- Soft launch the new taxonomy on Jul 12 (one-week observation where ops flags mismatches)
- Full cutover Jul 26 (start of FY27 Q3 sprints)

Monica — if you need me to pull 6 sample deals from the East region for the playshop I can do that by Monday.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales

Subject: Re: Playshop: Commit & Stage definition realignment — FY27 Q3

Thanks for the heads-up. From a finance ingestion perspective:
- We can accept a soft launch Jul 12 as Karthik suggested. During soft launch, ops should tag deals with "legacy" or "new-tax" so finance can build parallel reports.
- Recommended freeze window for roll reporting is Jul 20–Jul 30; no major taxonomy changes during that period. That gives us time to validate ETL and dashboards.
- Please include the Finance Ledger team on any follow-ups if we are changing recognition-related qualifiers.

I reviewed the draft and added a short appendix (p.3) with examples that show how revenue recognition aligns with Commit vs Close.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
